# WanaKana (build-time only)

WanaKana 5.3.1, MIT licence. The unmodified CommonJS module and licence were
extracted from the official npm tarball recorded with its integrity hash in
`source.json`. `tools/romanize_kana.cjs` uses `toRomaji` to generate Japanese ASCII
input aliases. This library is not executed or included in the Android app.

Upstream: https://github.com/WaniKani/WanaKana
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/wanakana
